title: Provably Convergent Primal-Dual DPO for Constrained LLM Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a component of a holistic 'Harmlessness' metric using GPT-4 as a judge. The evaluation prompt explicitly instructs the judge to penalize responses that contain stereotypes, discrimination, or injustice, alongside other general safety violations (e.g., toxicity, illegality).
